name: colA-top
role: Column 1, upper: chapter heading through the boxed universal-method quadratures.

name: colB-top
role: Column 2, upper: l = mu r^2 phidot, the d/dt -> d/dphi chain rule, orbit sketch, radial equation of motion.

name: colC-top
role: Column 3, upper: F(r) = -dV/dr rewritten in u, ending at -F(1/u) = (l^2/mu) u^2 [u + u''].

name: band-mid
role: Lower band, first rows: u = 1/r substitution, du/dphi chain rule, and the => RHS identity. These lines run across the column boundaries.

name: band-low-chain
role: Lower band: the LHS chain-rule expansion mu d/dt(dr/dt) = ... , and the LHS=RHS header beneath it.

name: band-A
role: Lower band, wrapped to the bottom-left of column 1: the CONTINUATION of the preceding LHS chain, reducing it to mu rddot = -(l^2/mu) u^2 d^2u/dphi^2.

name: band-low-box
role: Lower band, conclusion: the boxed generic trajectory equation and its caption, equating the reduced LHS to the RHS.

name: colC-bottom
role: Column 3, lower: the boxed trajectory (Binet) equation, its initial-condition note, and the du/dphi = 0 apsidal condition.

name: colD
role: Column 4: gravitational/Kepler case, shifted harmonic oscillator aside, homogeneous solution, apsidal-point ellipse sketch.

name: colD-figure
role: Column 4, whole-figure crop: the apsidal-point ellipse with its r0 chord, phi0 angle and both apsides, kept in one piece.

name: colE
role: Column 5 (second board): conic solution and eccentricity, then the same result via the universal method.
